name: client-workarounds
description: How to record, re-check, and remove GnollHack's workarounds for defects and limitations in third-party components -- .NET MAUI, SkiaSharp, the .NET runtime, .NET for Android and iOS, WinUI, Avalonia, CEF, FMOD, Sentry, and the operating systems -- and the known issues it cannot work around, in the register in DEVEL/workarounds. Covers WA and KI entries, IDs, every field, version sources, upstream status, WORKAROUND(WA-...) tags, the lint, linking a known issue to its Sentry issue, re-checks after a package, SDK or workload upgrade, and removal or resolution. Read whenever you add, change or remove a workaround, conclude that a crash or defect is upstream's with no workaround, upgrade a NuGet package, SDK or workload, file or update an upstream issue, meet a WORKAROUND(WA-...) tag or a KI- ID, or are asked to re-check the register.
